nodes.label: Node ID Format
nodes.rationale: Node IDs use full repo-relative path with extension dropped, every segment lowercased, joined with underscores, to keep same-named files in different directories distinct and match the AST extractor's generated IDs

nodes.label: Confidence Score Rubric
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; the bimodal distribution observed in production shows range guidance is collapsed to a binary, so fixed discrete values are used instead

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Graphify prioritizes audit trail integrity: never invent edges, always show token costs, never hide cohesion scores, and warn before running HTML viz on large graphs

nodes.label: Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: Graphify's query CLI uses case-folded substring matching with no stemming or synonyms, so queries must be expanded against the graph's actual vocabulary before traversal to avoid zero-hit queries

nodes.label: Shrink Guard
nodes.rationale: to_json refuses to write a graph smaller than the existing graph.json to prevent accidental data loss, requiring --force to override

nodes.label: Dual Extraction Model
nodes.rationale: Code is extracted structurally via AST with no LLM and no API key, while docs/papers/images use semantic extraction via Gemini or the host agent, allowing code-only corpora to run with zero external dependencies
